_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 01 완료 시제에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 3과 완료시제 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 현재완료는 과거를 나타내는 말과 함께 쓸 수 없다
have been to(경험) vs. have gone to(결과)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: A: Minho ______(A) angry since this morning.
B: What happened?
A: Someone ______(B) his bike by mistake yesterday.

choices.text: has been — broke
has been — has broken
was — has broken
was — broke
had been — has broken

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: Brian ______(A) at the bakery for five years before he ______(B) his job.

choices.text: worked — had changed
had worked — changed
had worked — had changed
had worked — has changed
worked — has changed

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: She [[has]] waiting for the bus since 8 o’clock.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Luckily, the store [[hasn’t closed]] yet when we got there.

questions.point_label: How long have+주어+p.p., have been to
questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: How long did you studied Chinese?
He’s already washed his car for the trip.
I’ve gone to Paris before with my family.
She’s watched the musical three times.
We have learned how to ski from our aunt.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Have you been running regularly?
Mina has been liking the singer for years.
We don’t have been meeting much lately.
I’ve been helping at an animal shelter.
He’s been waiting for the train 30 minutes ago.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: When I got home, my mother has already gone out.
I was glad that everyone had enjoyed the concert.
I have been tired for a week before I took a rest.
I’d lost my wallet, so I couldn’t buy the ticket.
Before I was invited to lunch, I had never tried Indian food.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 너는 해외에서 공부하는 것에 대해 생각해 본 적이 있니? (thought / you / ever / have / about)
→ ________________ studying abroad?

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 그 소년은 어제 그 농장에 가기 전까지 양을 본 적이 없었다. (a sheep / never / seen / had)
→ The boy ________________ before he went to the farm yesterday.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> I [[have tried]] Thai food before.

choices.text: Maria has left her phone on the train.
Tony has studied in his room all day long.
She hasn’t booked the ticket yet.
Mr. Park has taught math for 15 years.
He has been to Canada many times.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: 그는 4년 동안 기타를 쳐왔다. → He has played the guitar four years ago.
Mia는 오늘 아침부터 편지를 쓰고 있다. → Mia has written a letter since this morning.
그들은 오랫동안 이웃이 아니었다. → They have been not neighbors for a long time.
나는 누군가가 내 우산을 가져간 것을 발견했다. → I found someone has taken my umbrella.
지호는 그의 형이 떠난 것을 몰랐다. → Jiho didn’t know that his brother had left.

body: 오전 8시 30분 — 버스가 떠났다.   오전 9시 — 수호가 정류장에 도착했다.
→ When Suho got to the stop, ________________.

questions.prompt: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 쓰세요.
body: Tom started to play the piano at 4 p.m. He is still playing the piano.
questions.answer: has been playing the piano since 4 p.m.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 나는 전에 그의 삼촌을 만난 적이 있다. (meet, his uncle, before)
questions.answer: I have met his uncle before.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 그들은 아침 이후부터 춤추고 있다. (be, dance, since, morning)
questions.answer: They have been dancing since morning.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: ⓐ Have you ever gone to Jeju?
ⓑ Jinny has learned Spanish for 7 years.
ⓒ Rachel has bought a bag last week.
ⓓ Why haven’t you had your lunch yet?
ⓔ Hans has lost his key, so he can’t open the door.
ⓕ I have found my dog near the park two days ago.
